scripts.title: Noclip and Show Collisions
scripts.script:
-- i didnt encrypt it because its easy to make such thing
local collisions = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameViewport.Main:WaitForChild("workspace", 500):WaitForChild("Collisions", 500)
while task.wait() do
    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameViewport.Fade.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    local collisions = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameViewport.Main:WaitForChild("workspace", 500):WaitForChild("Collisions", 500)
    for _, collision in ipairs(collisions:GetChildren()) do
        if collision.Name == "Collision" then
            collision:SetAttribute("CanCollide", false)
            collision.Visible = true
        end
        if collision.Name == "Triangle" then
            collision:SetAttribute("CanCollide", false)
            collision.Visible = true
        end
        if collision.Name == "DoorCollision" then
            collision.Visible = true
            collision:SetAttribute("CanCollide", true)
        end
        if collision.Name == "SpawnMarker" then
            collision.Visible = true
        end
    end
end
